claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament is scheduled for April 9–12.
Round 1 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Thursday.
Round 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Friday.
Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Saturday.
Round 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Sunday.
Early coverage for rounds 1 and 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs from 1–3 p.m. ET on Amazon Prime Video.
Main coverage for rounds 1 and 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs from 3–7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
Main coverage for rounds 3 and 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs from 2–7 p.m. ET on CBS.
Streaming for rounds 1 and 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is available on Masters.com, ESPN App, and Paramount+.
Streaming for rounds 3 and 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is available on Paramount+ and Masters.com.
Masters.com and the Masters App provide free coverage including Amen Corner (holes 11, 12, 13), featured groups, and holes 4, 5, and 6 for the 2026 Masters Tournament.
"Welcome to the Masters" airs from 10 a.m.–noon ET on ESPN on Thursday and Friday for the 2026 Masters Tournament.
"Masters on the Range" is available on Masters.com and CBS Sports Network for the 2026 Masters Tournament.
